name: find_free_slot_from_top
purpose: Scans g_monster_table from slot 31 down to 0 and returns the first slot whose tile byte (+0) is 0; returns 0 when none is free (slot 0 is the party entry, so 0 doubles as 'none'). Used by spawn_chest_loot to place loot pieces. Ghidra named it CMDS_bf80 because the CMDS camp vector 1778:08f6 targets the same address in CMDS.OVL.

0x5c5a.name: g_monster_table
0x5c5a.meaning: save 0x6b4: monster/object table, 8 bytes per slot (+0 tile,+1 anim tile,+2 x,+3 y,+4 z,+5 value1,+6 value2/anim state,+7 value3)

name: set_dxy_from_facing
proto: void set_dxy_from_facing(int y, int x, int facing)
purpose: g_dx = x, g_dy = y, then steps one cell in dungeon facing: 0 north (y-1), 1 east (x+1), 2 south (y+1), 3 west (x-1). Ghidra params: param_1=y, param_2=x, param_3=facing.

name: select_search_cell_dungeon
purpose: Dungeon Search target prompt. Prints 0x84e6 and reads keys until 1,2,3,4 or space. 1: 'Left' facing+3; 2: 'Right' facing+1; 3: 'Ahead'; 4: 'Here' (g_dx/g_dy = party cell, return 1); space: 'Pass' return 0. For 1/2/3 the facing (mod 4) is turned into g_dx/g_dy via set_dxy_from_facing from the party cell and 1 is returned. Vector 1778:07be.
notes: The 'cVar1 != space -> return 1' test after the loop is unreachable.

name: print_found_object_name
purpose: Prints the name of a found object by tile/kind code: 1 chest, 2 sack of gold, 3 potion, 4 scroll, 5 weapon, 6 shield, 7 ring of keys, 8 (0x856c), 9 (0x8574), 0xa ring, 0xb armour, 0xc amulet, 0xd torches, 0xf food, 0x19 strange rock, 0x1e rotting body, 0x1f moldy corpse, else 'Nothing of note!' (0x85f4). Strings at 0x850e..0x85f4.

name: search_corpse
purpose: Searching a moldy corpse object (tile 0x1f) in monster slot. 1/8: the corpse is a creature: 1/4 tile 0xf (string 0x863a) else tile 2 (0x8642); slot tile and anim tile become it, value1 (+5) = rand 1..3, g_view_dirty |= 2, refresh_map_view. Else the slot is cleared and 1/32 (rand 0..31 == 0x13) the member is poisoned (0x8606, status 'P', play_random_tones(500,3000,40), status dirty); otherwise one of 'nothing!', 0x861a, 0x8622, 'a bloody pulp!' chosen by rand(0..rand(0..3)).

name: search_chest_for_trap
purpose: Reports whether a chest object is trapped. value1 bit 7 = trapped, low 7 bits = difficulty. d = trapped ? (v&0x7f) - INT + 30 : -(INT - 30) where INT = party record +0xe (0x55b6); roll = rand 1..30; pass = d/2 <= roll. Prints 'no trap!' when (pass && untrapped) || (!pass && trapped); otherwise 'a simple trap!' (pass, difficulty < 10), 'a complex trap!' (pass, > 20) or 0x8676 ('a trap!'). No state change.
notes: d is computed as uint; the quirk that a failed roll on a trapped chest reports 'no trap' is faithful.

name: dig_up_moonstone
proto: int dig_up_moonstone(int z, int y, int x)
purpose: Looks for a buried moonstone at (x,y,z) in g_location. Moonstone tables (index 0..7, addressed as base+1..8): x 0x5830, y 0x5838, location 0x5840 (g_moonstone_loc), z 0x5848 (save 0x28a/0x292/0x29a/0x2a2). A matching stone that already exists as an object (32 probes of find_object_at returning tile 0x19 with value1 == index, slot in g_dx) is skipped and the scan continues downward. Found: set_monster_slot(find_spawn_slot(), index, z, y, x, 0x19, 0x19), 'a strange rock!', g_view_dirty |= 2, return 1; else 0.

0x5840.name: g_moonstone_loc
0x5840.meaning: save 0x29a: 0 buried / 0xff in inventory (compared with g_location here)

name: harvest_reagents
purpose: Three reagent patches: x 0x3e66[i], y 0x3e6a[i], reagent index 0x3e6e[i], name pointer 0x3e72[i] (u16). Searchable only at g_hour == 0 and once per day (g_harvest_day[i] != g_day). Success: g_harvest_day[i] = g_day, n = rand 2..15 added to g_reagents[index] (cap 99), prints n (width 1 or 2) + 'sprigs of ' + name + 0x86ca; returns 1 else 0.

0x5858.name: g_harvest_day
0x5858.meaning: day each patch was last harvested

notes: Table strides are odd (4 bytes apart) but only 3 entries are used.

name: search_hidden_object
purpose: Hidden object search on the current map: 113 entries (0..0x70) with location 0x3f5c, z 0x3fce, x 0x4040, y 0x40b2, tile 0x3e78, quality 0x3eea. First entry matching (location, party z, x, y) is examined. Entries 0xd..0xf are repeatable specials that are never flagged: 0xd (keys) only when g_keys == 0 and the cell holds no object, 0xe (skull key) only when g_day != g_skull_key_day (and sets g_skull_key_day = g_day), 0xf (glass sword, count at 0x57e7) only when none owned and the cell is empty. Other entries: skipped if their bit in g_hidden_object_flags is set, otherwise the bit is set. Find: set_monster_slot(find_spawn_slot(), quality, z, y, x, tile, tile), g_view_dirty |= 2, print_found_object_name(tile); else 'nothing of note!'.

0x57b2.name: g_skull_key_day
0x57b2.meaning: day the skull key was last found

notes: When a flagged entry is skipped the scan continues with the next index (LAB_c5aa).

name: search_dungeon_cell
purpose: Dungeon Search. Needs a target member; no torch and no light spell -> 'You find: darkness!'. Else select_search_cell_dungeon picks the cell; cell = g_dungeon_map[z][y&7][x&7]; skill = (2z - DEX + 30)/2. 'You find: ' then by high nibble: 0 'Nothing of note!'; 1/2/3 ladders 'Nothing hidden on the ladder!'; 4 chest: rand 1..30 > skill ? (cell == 0x40 'No trap' else level = z) : level = rand 1..8; level <4 'A simple trap', <7 'A trap', else 'A complex trap'; 5 fountain; 6 pit: 0x60 'Nothing hidden in the pit!', 0x61 (0x87a2) cell = 0x60 and the cell one level down |= 8, redraw (DUNGEON 9c60(1) + rect_effect(0xb7,0xb7,8,8)); 0x62 bomb trap: on success 'A bomb trap!' and cell &= 8 else 'Nothing of note!'; 7 'Treasure!'; 8 field names by low nibble (sleep/poison/fire/electric/energy); 9 'This tile is impossible!'; 0xa/0xe/0xf 'Nothing hidden on the door!'; 0xb '...wall!'; 0xc: style 1 stalactite, style 2 caved-in passage, else skeleton 'It crumbles away!' cell = 0xb0|(cell&8) + redraw; 0xd 'A hidden door!' cell = (cell&8)-0x20 (0xe0/0xe8) + redraw.

0x595a.name: g_dungeon_map
0x595a.meaning: save 0x3b4: dungeon map, z*0x40 + y*8 + x

notes: The bomb trap writes cell &= 8 (not |=); kept as is.

name: cmd_search
purpose: Search command (dispatch_command 'S', vector 1778:06aa). Dungeon (0x21..0x28) -> search_dungeon_cell. Else get_direction, select_target_member, target = party+(dx,dy). Chest object (tile 1) in slots 1..31 at the cell (z checked outside combat) -> 'Thou dost find ' + search_chest_for_trap. Topmost object 0x1f (find_object_at_rev) -> 'Thou dost find ' + search_corpse(member, g_dx). Otherwise a furniture prefix by map tile (0x2b stump, 0x4f wall, 0x5a shelf, 0x5c/0x5d bookshelf, 0xa1 well, 0xa5 desk, 0xa6 barrel, 0xa8 vanity, 0xab/0xac bed, 0xad dresser, 0xaf trunk, 0xb2 brazier, 0xbc fireplace, else 'T') + 'hou dost find ': tile 0x4e -> 'a hidden door!' and the tile becomes 0xb9 (0xb8 in combat), view dirty; else dig_up_moonstone (skipped for tile 0xdc) -> harvest_reagents -> search_hidden_object.

name: jimmy_chest
purpose: Jimmy a chest object. Needs a target member. value1 < 0x80 -> 'Key broke!'; else roll rand 1..30 against byte(((v&0x7f) - DEX + 30)/2): roll greater -> 'Success!' and value1 &= 0x7f; else 'Key broke!'. Each failure plays play_tone_sweep(50,1,2000,800) and costs a key.
notes: Ghidra shows 4 arguments at the call site; only the slot is used.

name: jimmy_dungeon_chest
purpose: Dungeon Jimmy on the party's own cell (prompt 0x8a7a). (cell & 0xf7) == 0x40 (unlocked chest): with keys 'Key broke!' (-1 key) else 'No keys!'. Other 0x4x chests: no keys 'No keys!'; rand 1..30 > (2z - DEX + 30)/2 -> 'Chest unlocked' and cell = 0x40|(cell&8); else 'Key broke!' (-1 key). 0x7x 'Already open!'; else 0x8ac8.

name: cmd_jimmy
purpose: Jimmy command (dispatch 'J', vector 1778:0692). Dungeon -> jimmy_dungeon_chest. No keys 'No Keys!'. get_direction; tile t at party+(dx,dy): 0x97/0x98 magic doors 'Key broke!' (-1 key). 0x84/0x85 (stocks/manacles): outside combat an object must be there ('No one is there!'); member chosen, rand 0..29 >= DEX -> 'Key broke!' (-1 key); success in a settlement (loc < 0x7f): npc = find_npc_by_slot(g_dx) (-1 -> "Couldn't find this npc"), npc mode (0x5f68) cleared, if !is_npc_killed: schedule AI types 0x5d5e..0x5d60 = 5, ' I thank thee!', karma += 2 (cap 99); then set_npc_killed(npc); in combat the tile becomes 0x44 and 'Unlocked'. 0xb9/0xbb locked doors: DEX check, success tile-1 'Unlocked!'. Else chest object at the cell -> jimmy_chest(slot), or 'No lock!'.

name: spawn_chest_loot
proto: void spawn_chest_loot(int *found, int quality, int z, int y, int x, int amount, int kind)
purpose: Places one loot object next to the opened chest. kind 3/4: amount-1 (item index). kind 1: amount = rand 1..quality; kind 2 (gold): amount = rand 1..3*quality. Slot = find_free_slot_from_top (0 = none -> nothing). set_monster_slot(slot, amount, z, y, x, kind, kind); outside combat anim state = 0 and z stored, in combat anim state = 0x20; g_view_dirty |= 2; refresh_map_view; prints 'Found:' once (via *found) then print_found_object_name(kind).
notes: Rust passes the found flag as &mut i16 instead of a DGROUP pointer.

name: roll_fixed_chest_loot
proto: void roll_fixed_chest_loot(int *found, int z, int y, int x, int quality)
purpose: For loot classes i = 7..0 (kind 0x4123[i], min quality 0x412b[i], max count 0x4133[i]): if min <= quality and min <= rand 1..30 then amount = (max == 1 ? 1 : rand 1..max) and spawn_chest_loot(found, quality, z, y, x, amount, kind).

name: roll_random_chest_loot
proto: void roll_random_chest_loot(int *found, int z, int y, int x, int quality)
purpose: quality/2 + 1 draws: r = rand 0..47; if 0x416c[r] <= quality and <= rand 1..30 then spawn_chest_loot(found, quality, z, y, x, r, 0x413c[r]) - the table index r is also the item index/amount.

name: open_chest
proto: void open_chest(int z, int y, int x)
purpose: Open the chest object at (x,y,z). Slots 1..31 at the cell (z ignored in combat): tile 1 found; tile 0xe prints 0x8b64 and returns; none 'Nothing to open!'. select_target_member; quality = value1; slot cleared; view dirty |= 2; in a settlement karma -= 2 (min 0). quality bit 7: 'Trapped!' + trap_effect(member); if in combat the member is now dead ('D') its roster entry gets flag 0x20 and its monster slot tile/anim tile = 0x1e, active member cleared if it was this one, refresh. Then roll_fixed_chest_loot and roll_random_chest_loot with quality & 0x7f; 'Chest empty!' if nothing was found.

0xba14.name: g_combat_roster
0xba14.meaning: combat roster: +2 flags, +3 member, +4 slot, +6 x, +7 y

name: open_dungeon_chest
purpose: Dungeon Open on the party cell: 0x4x chest -> select_target_member, (cell & 7) != 0 -> trap_effect(member), cell = 0x70|(cell&8), 'Chest opened'; 0x7x 'Already Open!'; else 0x8bb6.

name: cmd_open
purpose: Open command (dispatch 'O', vector 1778:069e). Dungeon -> open_dungeon_chest. Else restores the timed door (set_town_map_tile(g_door_y,g_door_x,g_door_tile)), get_direction, tile t at party+(dx,dy): 0xaf "It's open!"; 0x99 'Too heavy!'; 0xb8/0xba doors: g_door_timer = 4, g_door_x/y/tile saved, tile = 0x44, g_view_dirty = 1, 'Opened!'; 0x97/0x98/0xb9/0xbb 'Locked!'; everything else open_chest(z,y,x).

name: take_item
proto: void take_item(int slot, uint value, int kind)
purpose: Adds a picked-up object to the inventory; slot 0x20 = no object to clear. kind 1 'Open it first!' (return); 2 gold += value (cap 9999); 3 potion name 0x419c[value] + ' potion!', g_potions[value]++ (cap 99); 4 scroll: value 0xff 'The plans for the HMS Cape!' g_hms_cape_plans = 0xff, else 'A scroll!' + rune font name 0x41ac[value&7], g_scrolls[value]++; 5,6,9..0xc equipment: g_inventory[value] += 1 (values 0x1b/0x1d += 5, cap 99), name 0x17f6[value] + 0x8d06; 7 keys (value < 0x80, 0x8cb4) or skull keys (0x57b1, 'odd key'), cap 99, 0x8cba/0x8cbe; 8 gems; 0xd torches; 0xe sandalwood box (g_sandalwood_box = 0xff, 0x5b9d |= 0x80); 0xf food (cap 9999); 0x19 moonstone g_moonstone_loc[value] = 0xff; 0x1b magic carpet++ (cap 99; in location 0x11 remove_npc(0x16)); 0xb4 shard[value&3] = 0xff ('The Shard of ' Falsehood/Hatred/Cowardice); 0xb5 crown (set_npc_killed + remove_npc of the NPC owning the slot); 0xb6 sceptre; 0xb7 amulet; others 'Nothing to get!' (return). Tail: slot < 0x20 cleared, g_status_dirty = 1, g_view_dirty |= 2.

0x5b9d.name: g_save_unk_5f7
0x5b9d.meaning: save 0x5f7: bit 7 set when the sandalwood box is taken

notes: The 9999 cap is passed as the address of the 'Missed!' string (0x270f) - a constant, not a pointer.

name: get_dungeon_chest_contents
purpose: Dungeon Get (0x8da4). 0x4x 'Must open first!'; 0x7x open chest: cell &= 8, 'contents of chest You find:', seven rolls i = 0..6: rand 1..(4z+4) >= g_unk_41bc[i] -> i == 5 potion (kind 3) index rand 0..7, i == 6 scroll (kind 4) rand 0..7, else kind 0x41cc[i] with value rand 1..max (max = 8z for i == 1 gold, else 0x41c4[i]), each via take_item(0x20, value, kind). Else 'Not here!'.

0x41bc.name: g_dungeon_loot_threshold
0x41bc.meaning: minimum roll per dungeon chest loot class

notes: g_unk_41bc (24 bytes) holds all three 8-byte rows: thresholds, maxima, kinds.

name: cmd_get
purpose: Get command (dispatch 'G', vector 1778:0686). Dungeon -> get_dungeon_chest_contents. get_direction; prints 0x8de6; slots 1..31 at party+(dx,dy) (z outside combat) with tile < 0x10, 0x19, 0x1b or 0xb4..0xb7 -> take_item(slot, value1, tile). Else map tile: 0x9a/0x9b plates (only from dy == +1 / -1, else "Can't reach plate!") become 0x95, 0x9c (table with food; not from the sides) becomes 0x9b/0x9a; these print 0x8e04/0x8e24/0x8e58, +1 food, karma -1. 0x2d crops -> 0x2c 'Crops picked!', +1 food, status dirty, karma -1. 0xb0/0xb1 sconce: tile 0x44, g_view_dirty = 1, rebuild_light_map outside combat, g_torch_turns = 100, 'Borrowed!' + tone. Else 'Nothing to get!'.

name: remove_item_from_all_members
purpose: remove_equipped_item(item, i) for every party member i < g_party_count; returns the number of members that had it. Vector 1778:088a.

name: count_combatants_by_side
purpose: g_dy = number of live party-side combatants, g_dx = live enemy-side combatants (roster entries with flags != 0 and bit 0x20 clear, side from combatant_side). Vector 1778:070a.

name: leave_combat
purpose: Combatant leaves the battlefield. Frigate transport (tile & 0xf8 == 0x20): 'Stay with ship!' return 0. Party member: g_combat_exit = dir if unset, else a different dir with g_combat_flags & 0x80 -> 'All must use the same exit!' beep return 0. g_focus_blink = 1, count_combatants_by_side, 'Victory!' (0x8ea6) when g_dx == 0 else 'Escape!', play_tone_sweep(40,1,2000,1200), g_active_member = 0xff, COMBAT b4c6(-1 - roster_index), draw_status_window, refresh_map_view, return 1.

0x58a0.name: g_combat_exit
0x58a0.meaning: exit direction chosen by the first leaver ('M' = endgame)

notes: Ghidra's CMDS_dba0 (1000:dba0) is the 'Escape!' branch of this function.

name: fn_1000_dba0_fragment
purpose: Not a function: code tail of leave_combat (db32) reached by a JNZ at db72; Ghidra labelled it CMDS_dba0 because the CMDS Klimb vector 1778:091a targets this address in CMDS.OVL. Translated as a no-op.

name: move_combatant
purpose: Moves a combatant one step (1 W, 2 E, 3 N, 4 S; direction name printed). Inside the 11x11 field COMBAT a290(y,x,tile) decides: blocked -> 'Blocked!', beep, flush_keyboard, 0; else roster +6/+7 and monster slot x/y updated, play_footstep_sound, COMBAT b3aa(y,x) when g_combat_flags & 0x82 (dungeon room triggers), 1. Off the field -> leave_combat(dir, roster_index). Vector 1778:05ba.

name: combat_klimb
purpose: Combat Klimb (vector 1778:06f2). Prints 0x8ede. Tile under the party position: in a dungeon room (flags & 2) on 0xc8 with g_tiles_patched asks 0x8ee6: 3/'U' keeps 0xc8, 4/'D' -> 0xc9. 0xc8 -> 0x8eec, exit 5; 0x86 (with flags & 0x80) or 0xc9 -> 0x8ef2, exit 6; both return leave_combat(exit, g_active_combatant). Otherwise get_direction and climb onto an adjacent tile 0x4c with no object (roster/monster x,y updated, COMBAT b3aa); wrong target prints 0x8efa and returns 0; returns 1.
notes: Uses g_party_x/y as the active combatant position (callers set them).

name: combat_check_absorbed
purpose: Endgame trigger: active combatant live, on row y == 2, and the view object byte at 0xac74 + x (g_view_objects + 0x10) has tile & 0xfc == 0x3c -> g_combat_exit = 'M', newline, COMSUBS e274(active) prints the name, 'is absorbed!', tone, g_active_member = 0xff, status window, COMBAT b4c6(-1 - active), refresh. Vector 1778:06e6.

0xac64.name: g_view_objects
0xac64.meaning: object layer of the view, 16-byte rows

notes: 0xac74 is row 1 of g_view_objects although the combatant is on row 2 - TODO(verify).

name: print_refusal
purpose: Prints msg, then by reason 1: 0x8f12, 2: ' Not here', 3: ' Funny, no response!'; newline; beep(150,220), beep(150,150); returns 1. Vector 1778:064a.

name: set_active_player
purpose: 'Set active plr:' in combat. Finds the roster entry with flags bit 7, party side (combatant_side == 0) and member index == member; valid when flags & 0x2c == 0. Valid: g_active_member = member, COMSUBS e274(entry) prints the name, newline, draw_status_window, return 1; else 'Invalid!' return 0. Vector 1778:05c6.

name: combat_turn_effects
purpose: apply_ring_effects(g_active_combatant), COMSUBS e236, then g_protection_turns (if not 0 or 0xff) is decremented; on reaching 0 g_status_icon = 0 and g_status_dirty = 1. Vector 1778:0596.

name: end_combat
purpose: Combat aftermath called by ROOT fight_monster (vector 1778:0896). g_combat_exit == 'M' -> ENDGAME a8d8. Copies the 256-byte backup at 0xa9fc back over g_monster_table. If g_combat_flags & 0x82 == 0: slot < 0x20 is either destroyed (tile, anim tile, x, y, z = 0) or, when g_no_more_enemies and the slot is a pirate ship (tile & 0xfc == 0x2c), captured: tile/anim tile -= 8, value1 = 99 (hull), anim state = 2. Then newline and g_location = g_location_backup.

name: is_cell_blocked_for
proto: int is_cell_blocked_for(int roster_index, int y, int x)
purpose: Returns 1 when (y,x) is blocked for the combatant: outside 0..10 it is open only if the entry's flags have bit 1 (may leave); inside, 1 - COMBAT a290(y, x, tile of its monster slot). Vector 1778:0722.

name: is_combatant_surrounded
purpose: Tests south, east, west, north neighbours with is_cell_blocked_for; true when all four are blocked. Vector 1778:072e.

name: chaos_sword_passout
purpose: Roster entries 0..5: first party member with flag bit 0 set: bit cleared, '<name> passes out!', play_sweep_noise, remove_equipped_item(0x23 Chaos sword, member), incapacitate_combatant(entry); returns the entry index or -1 if none. Vector 1778:06fe.
notes: play_sweep_noise's third argument is the constant 0x7530 (address of a string + 2, used as a number).
